provisions.summary: Miltenyi must sell Miltenyi Products to Bellicum under the Agreement terms.
provisions.text: Miltenyi desires to sell to Bellicum, and Bellicum desires to purchase from Miltenyi, the Miltenyi Products in accordance with the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement.

provisions.summary: Bellicum must purchase Miltenyi Products from Miltenyi under the Agreement terms.
provisions.text: Miltenyi desires to sell to Bellicum, and Bellicum desires to purchase from Miltenyi, the Miltenyi Products in accordance with the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement.

provisions.summary: Bellicum may use Miltenyi Products solely for the Permitted Use in connection with development and manufacture of Bellicum Products.
provisions.text: Bellicum desires to use certain Miltenyi Products (as defined below) solely for the Permitted Use (as defined below) in connection with the development and manufacture of certain Bellicum Products (as defined below) by Bellicum and/or its Subcontractors or Licensees (as defined below) for use in preclinical and clinical development programs and, if approved, for commercial use;

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must supply and sell Miltenyi Products to Bellicum or its Licensees or Subcontractors.
provisions.text: Miltenyi will non-exclusively supply and sell to Bellicum or its Licensees or Subcontractors

provisions.summary: Bellicum or its Licensees or Subcontractors must purchase Miltenyi Products from Miltenyi.
provisions.text: Bellicum or its Licensees or Subcontractors will purchase from Miltenyi, Miltenyi Products listed on Exhibit B solely for the Permitted Use

provisions.summary: Bellicum must not use Miltenyi Products for any purpose other than Permitted Use.
provisions.text: Bellicum shall not use, and shall cause its Subcontractors and Licensees not to use the Miltenyi Products and/or any component thereof for any purpose or in any manner whatsoever other than a Permitted Use expressly set forth in Section 2.2(a) above.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi Products must not be used for in vivo administration in humans or as an ingredient of a Bellicum Product.
provisions.text: any and all Miltenyi Products supplied hereunder (or any components thereof) shall not be used directly (i) for in vivo administration in humans; or (ii) as an ingredient of a Bellicum Product.

provisions.summary: Bellicum must promptly notify Miltenyi in writing of any additional Bellicum Product manufactured using Miltenyi Products.
provisions.text: Bellicum shall promptly notify Miltenyi in writing of any additional Bellicum Product from time to time manufactured by or on behalf of Bellicum (or any of its Licensees, if any) by using one or more Miltenyi Products, which Bellicum Product shall be added to Exhibit A by amendment; subsequently, the Parties shall agree upon the Bellicum Product specific Module within sixty (60) days.

provisions.summary: Bellicum must not sell, market, export, transfer, or re-export Miltenyi Products without Miltenyi’s express prior written consent.
provisions.text: Bellicum specifically agrees not to, and agrees not to cause any Third Party to, sell, market, export, transfer, or re-export Miltenyi Products without Miltenyi’s express prior written consent.

provisions.summary: Bellicum has the right to use, and to permit its Subcontractors and Licensees to use, Miltenyi Products for Ex Vivo Cell Processing in the manufacture of Bellicum Products for use in the Field in the Territory, in accordance with the Agreement and Applicable Laws.
provisions.text: the supply of the Miltenyi Products hereunder conveys to Bellicum the limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable (except as expressly provided herein, including as set forth in Article 17) right to use, and to permit its Subcontractors and Licensees to use the Miltenyi Products solely for Ex Vivo Cell Processing in the manufacture of Bellicum Products for use in the Field in the Territory (including for research, pre-clinical, clinical, regulatory and commercial purposes), in accordance with applicable Regulatory Authority requirements and approvals (including (to the extent applicable) any relevant clinical trial protocol, IND, and/or IRB approval pertaining to such Bellicum Products), in each case consistent with the terms and conditions of this Agreement and in accordance with Applicable Laws (the “Permitted Use”).

provisions.summary: Bellicum must instruct and oblige its Licensees and Subcontractors to comply with the Agreement and Applicable Laws regarding use of Miltenyi Products.
provisions.text: Bellicum shall instruct and oblige its Licensees and Subcontractors accordingly.

provisions.summary: Bellicum must ensure use of Miltenyi Products is supervised by a technically qualified individual.
provisions.text: Use of the Miltenyi Products by Bellicum, its Licensees or Subcontractors shall be supervised by a technically qualified individual.

provisions.summary: Bellicum and its Licensees/Subcontractors may not modify or alter Miltenyi Products except for Permitted Use without Miltenyi's consent.
provisions.text: Bellicum further will not, and will cause its Licensees and Subcontractors not to, without express prior written consent from Miltenyi: (1) Modify or alter, or cause any Third Party to modify or alter, any Miltenyi Product supplied hereunder other than in connection with its Permitted Use;

provisions.summary: Bellicum and its Licensees/Subcontractors may not reverse engineer, disassemble, or analyze Miltenyi Products except as necessary to achieve the Agreement's purposes.
provisions.text: Reverse engineer, disassemble or otherwise analyze, or cause any Third Party to reverse engineer, disassemble or otherwise analyze, any Miltenyi Product supplied hereunder, in whole or in part; provided, however, that the foregoing shall not limit the right or ability of Bellicum or its Licensees or Subcontractors to identify defects, troubleshoot problems, evaluate, test, use or conduct any study utilizing any Miltenyi Product(s) as reasonably necessary to achieve the purposes of this Agreement;

provisions.summary: Bellicum may not transfer Miltenyi Products to Third Parties except to its Subcontractors or Licensees for Permitted Use or training/validation.
provisions.text: Transfer any Miltenyi Product supplied hereunder to any Third Party, except to Bellicum Subcontractors or Licensees solely for the Permitted Use or for training or validation purposes in connection with Bellicum’s development and commercialization of Bellicum Product;

provisions.summary: Bellicum may not resell Miltenyi Products to any Third Party, including its own Subcontractors and Licensees, without Miltenyi's written permission.
provisions.text: Resell Miltenyi Product supplied hereunder to any Third Party, including Bellicum Subcontractors and Licensees, without prior express written permission from Miltenyi;

provisions.summary: Bellicum may not transfer, use, import, or export Miltenyi Products outside the Designated Countries.
provisions.text: Transfer, use, import or export any Miltenyi Product supplied to Bellicum hereunder in any country or territory other than the Designated Countries.

provisions.summary: The Parties must evaluate regulatory requirements for use of Miltenyi Products in Additional Countries upon Bellicum's reasonable written request.
provisions.text: The Parties agree, upon reasonable written request by Bellicum from time to time during the term of this Agreement, to evaluate the regulatory requirements for utilizing of Miltenyi Products for manufacture of Bellicum Products in the requested Additional Country(ies).

provisions.summary: The Parties must negotiate in good faith to agree on terms for Miltenyi's provision of Additional Work for Additional Countries.
provisions.text: the Parties will negotiate in good faith with the goal of entering into an agreement on mutually acceptable terms with respect to Miltenyi’s provision of such Additional Work.

provisions.summary: Bellicum must inform Miltenyi in writing at least 12 months before any intended regulatory filing in an Additional Country.
provisions.text: Bellicum shall inform Miltenyi in writing at least twelve (12) months in advance prior to any intended regulatory filing in an Additional Country.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi reserves the right to manufacture, use, sell, export, import, or commercialize Miltenyi Products in any manner and for any purpose.
provisions.text: Miltenyi reserves the right, at its sole discretion and without any restriction or limitation whatsoever, to manufacture, have manufactured, use, have used, sell, have sold, offer for sale, export, import or otherwise commercialize or dispose of Miltenyi Products in any manner and for any purpose whatsoever.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must take into account Bellicum's written concerns regarding proposed Affiliates or Subcontractors for manufacturing.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall reasonably take into account Bellicum’s written concerns regarding proposed Affiliate(s) or Subcontractor(s);

provisions.summary: Miltenyi is responsible for performance and compliance of all delegated and subcontracted activities by its Affiliates and Subcontractors.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall be solely and fully responsible for the performance of all delegated and subcontracted activities by its Affiliates and Subcontractor(s), including compliance with the terms of this Agreement and the Quality Agreement (as applicable), and in no event shall any such delegation or subcontract release Miltenyi from any of its obligations under this Agreement.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must ensure its and its Affiliates’ and Subcontractors’ manufacturing and supply activities comply with Applicable Laws.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall have sole responsibility for ensuring, and shall ensure, that Miltenyi’s and its Affiliates’ and Subcontractors’ activities and performance in connection with the manufacture of Miltenyi Products and the supply of such Miltenyi Products to Bellicum under this Agreement are at all times in compliance with Applicable Laws.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must obtain and maintain all required licenses, permits, authorizations, or registrations for manufacturing and delivery of Miltenyi Products.
provisions.text: it shall be the sole responsibility of Miltenyi to obtain and maintain, and Miltenyi shall obtain and maintain, all licenses, permits, authorizations, or registrations required by Applicable Laws in order for Miltenyi, its Affiliates, and/or Subcontractors (as the case may be) to manufacture and make Delivery of Miltenyi Products, except as otherwise provided in this Agreement, at Miltenyi’s expense.

provisions.summary: Bellicum must ensure use of Miltenyi Products for Permitted Use is in compliance with Applicable Laws.
provisions.text: Bellicum shall have sole responsibility for ensuring, and shall ensure, that the use of the Miltenyi Products for their respective Permitted Use by Bellicum, its Subcontractors and Licensees (as the case may be) is at all times in compliance with Applicable Laws.

provisions.summary: Bellicum must obtain and maintain all required licenses, permits, authorizations, registrations, validations, or testing for use of Miltenyi Products.
provisions.text: it shall be the sole responsibility of Bellicum to obtain and maintain, and Bellicum shall obtain and maintain, all licenses, permits, authorizations, registrations, additional validations or additional testing required by Applicable Laws in order for Bellicum, its Subcontractors and Licensees to use the Miltenyi Products for the Permitted Use, at Bellicum’s expense.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must comply with all reasonable requests for assistance by Bellicum in obtaining necessary licenses, permits, etc., with scope and costs agreed by the Parties.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall comply with all reasonable requests for assistance by Bellicum in connection with Bellicum’s efforts to obtain such licenses, permits, authorizations, registrations, additional validations or additional testing, to the extent applicable to the Miltenyi Products; provided that the Parties shall agree on the scope of such assistance to be provided by Miltenyi and upon the reasonable costs to be paid by Bellicum to Miltenyi for such assistance.

provisions.summary: Bellicum must promptly notify Miltenyi in writing if it receives notice from a Regulatory Authority about safety or quality issues with Miltenyi Products.
provisions.text: Bellicum shall promptly notify Miltenyi of the same in writing.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must make efforts to cure safety or quality issues with Miltenyi Products as promptly as possible, at its sole expense unless issues solely relate to Bellicum’s Permitted Use.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall make [...***...] to cure such safety or quality issue(s) as they relate to the Miltenyi Products as promptly as possible, and unless such issues solely relate to Bellicum’s Permitted Use of the relevant Miltenyi Product(s) in connection with the manufacture or use of a Bellicum Product, such efforts shall be at Miltenyi’s sole expense.

provisions.summary: Each Party and its representatives must not offer or pay anything of value to obtain or retain business through improper advantage or violate anti-bribery laws.
provisions.text: such Party, and, to its actual knowledge, its owners, directors, officers, employees, and any agent, representative, Subcontractor or other Third Party acting for or on such its behalf, shall not, directly or indirectly, offer, pay, promise to pay, or authorize such offer, promise or payment, of anything of value, to any person for the purposes of obtaining or retaining business through any improper advantage in connection with this Agreement, or that would otherwise violate any Applicable Laws, rules and regulations concerning or relating to public or commercial bribery or corruption;

provisions.summary: Each Party's financial books, accounts, records, and invoices related to the Agreement must be complete and accurate in all material respects.
provisions.text: its financial books, accounts, records and invoices related to this Agreement or related to any work conducted for or on behalf of the other Party are and will be complete and accurate in all material respects.

provisions.summary: Each Party may request in writing that the other Party complete a compliance certification regarding anti-bribery and record-keeping obligations.
provisions.text: Each Party may request in writing from time to time that the other Party complete a compliance certification regarding the foregoing in this Section 2.6.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi may stop supplying if supply is believed to violate laws or IP.
provisions.text: Nothing herein contained shall oblige Miltenyi to continue supplying ... if such supply or purchase is reasonably believed by Miltenyi or Bellicum, as the case may be, based on objective grounds, to violate Applicable Laws or such Party’s licenses, or if the Miltenyi Products supplied to Bellicum infringe, or are alleged to infringe, a Third Party’s Intellectual Property Rights.

provisions.summary: Bellicum may stop ordering or purchasing if purchase is believed to violate laws or IP.
provisions.text: Nothing herein contained shall oblige Miltenyi to continue supplying, or Bellicum to continue ordering or purchasing, any Miltenyi Product if such supply or purchase is reasonably believed by Miltenyi or Bellicum, as the case may be, based on objective grounds, to violate Applicable Laws or such Party’s licenses, or if the Miltenyi Products supplied to Bellicum infringe, or are alleged to infringe, a Third Party’s Intellectual Property Rights.

provisions.summary: Bellicum may transfer Miltenyi Products or request delivery to its Affiliate, Subcontractor, or Licensee for Permitted Use.
provisions.text: Bellicum shall have the right to transfer Miltenyi Product(s) purchased hereunder, or to request from Miltenyi, by notice in writing, that Miltenyi Deliver any Miltenyi Product(s) purchased hereunder to an Affiliate of Bellicum or a Subcontractor or Licensee of Bellicum Product designated by Bellicum, solely for the purpose of the Permitted Use, subject to the payment to Miltenyi of all additional expenses (if any) incurred by Miltenyi in connection with such provision and transfer of Miltenyi Product(s) to Bellicum’s designee;

provisions.summary: Each Subcontractor or Licensee of Bellicum to whom Miltenyi Products are transferred must be bound in writing by consistent limitations and obligations.
provisions.text: each Subcontractor or Licensee of Bellicum to whom Miltenyi Products are transferred shall be bound in writing by limitations and obligations that are consistent with the corresponding limitations and obligations imposed on Bellicum

provisions.summary: Bellicum remains responsible and liable to Miltenyi for payment and use of Miltenyi Product by its Subcontractors and Licensees.
provisions.text: Bellicum will nevertheless continue to remain fully and primarily responsible and liable to Miltenyi for payment of the Product Price and for the use of the Miltenyi Product by any Subcontractor and Licensee to whom a Miltenyi Product is transferred.

provisions.summary: Bellicum may not grant rights under Miltenyi IP except as expressly permitted and necessary for Permitted Use.
provisions.text: in no event shall Bellicum grant any rights under Miltenyi Intellectual Property Rights other than as expressly permitted hereunder and as are necessary to use Miltenyi Product for the purpose of the Permitted Use, or any rights that are otherwise inconsistent with the terms of this Agreement or the Quality Agreement.

provisions.summary: Bellicum must impose consistent limitations and obligations on Subcontractors or Licensees and notify Miltenyi of their details.
provisions.text: Bellicum shall first impose limitations and obligations on such Subcontractors or Licensees, in writing, that are consistent with the corresponding limitations and obligations imposed on Bellicum hereunder, and Bellicum shall notify Miltenyi of the name and contact information for each such Subcontractor or Licensee that it shares such rights with, in writing, in accordance with Article 16 of this Agreement.

provisions.summary: Bellicum must promptly notify Miltenyi in writing of any additional Licensee contemplating use of Miltenyi Products for manufacture.
provisions.text: Bellicum shall promptly notify Miltenyi in writing of any additional Licensee contemplating the use of Miltenyi Product(s) for the manufacture of a Bellicum Product from time to time, which Licensee shall be added to the Bellicum Product specific Module by amendment.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must enter into a direct supply agreement with any Licensee nominated by Bellicum at Bellicum's reasonable written request.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall enter into a direct supply agreement for Miltenyi Products with any Licensee nominated by Bellicum, materially consistent with the terms and conditions of this Agreement and the Quality Agreement (as applicable), except as agreed otherwise in writing between Miltenyi and the respective Bellicum Licensee.

provisions.summary: Bellicum remains responsible and liable to Miltenyi for acts or omissions of its Affiliates, Subcontractors, and Licensees.
provisions.text: Bellicum shall, in relation to Miltenyi, at all times and in all respects continue to remain fully and primarily responsible and liable to Miltenyi for the performance and the acts or omissions of its Affiliate, Subcontractor, and Licensee in connection with the subject matter of this Agreement, including the failure of an Affiliate, Subcontractor, or Licensee of Bellicum to comply with all of the limitations and obligations imposed on Bellicum hereunder.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi remains responsible and liable to Bellicum for acts or omissions of its Affiliates and Subcontractors.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall, in relation to Bellicum, at all times and in all respects continue to remain fully and primarily responsible and liable to Bellicum for the performance and the acts or omissions of its Affiliates and Subcontractors in connection with the subject matter of this Agreement, including the failure of an Affiliate or Subcontractor of Miltenyi to comply with all of the limitations and obligations imposed on Miltenyi hereunder.

provisions.summary: No permitted delegation or subcontracting releases a Party from its obligations under the Agreement.
provisions.text: in no event shall any permitted delegation or subcontracting of any activities to be performed in connection with this Agreement release a Party from any of its limitations or obligations under this Agreement.

provisions.summary: Each Party shall appoint an appropriately qualified individual to serve as an alliance manager.
provisions.text: Each Party shall appoint an appropriately qualified individual to serve as an alliance manager under this Agreement (the “Alliance Manager”).

provisions.summary: Each Party shall initially appoint up to three representatives to the JSC.
provisions.text: Each Party shall initially appoint up to three (3) representatives (or their designees) to the JSC, excluding the Alliance Manager of each Party who will attend JSC meetings in a non- voting capacity.

provisions.summary: Each Party may replace its JSC representatives at any time upon written notice to the other Party.
provisions.text: Each Party may replace its JSC representatives at any time upon written notice to the other Party; provided, however, that neither Party may replace a representative on the JSC with an individual with lower seniority without the approval of the other Party, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld.

provisions.summary: The JSC shall meet at least two times each Calendar Year, with at least one in-person meeting.
provisions.text: The JSC shall meet at least two times each Calendar Year, and at least one such JSC meeting shall be in person/ face-to-face with alternating locations (for in person/ face-to-face meetings only), unless otherwise agreed in writing by both Parties.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi shall manufacture or have manufactured the Miltenyi Products to meet the agreed Product Specifications.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall manufacture or have manufactured the Miltenyi Products to meet the agreed Product Specifications, as then in effect, as published by Miltenyi from time to time, or as set forth in the Quality Agreement, as applicable.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must manufacture and quality control all Miltenyi Products in compliance with Agreed Standards, the Quality Agreement, and Applicable Laws.
provisions.text: All Miltenyi Products shall be manufactured and quality controlled in compliance with and pursuant to: (i) the Agreed Standards, (ii) the requirements of the Quality Agreement, if applicable, and (iii) Applicable Laws.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must have standard analytical testing performed on each batch of Miltenyi Product to be shipped to Bellicum.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall have standard analytical testing performed on each batch of Miltenyi Product to be shipped to Bellicum, in accordance with Agreed Standards and the procedures described in the corresponding documentation, to verify that Miltenyi Product meets Product Specifications and that it was manufactured in accordance with Agreed Standards and Applicable Laws.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must manufacture and quality control all Miltenyi Products under an appropriate quality system in accordance with Agreed Standards.
provisions.text: All Miltenyi Products supplied under this Agreement shall be manufactured and quality controlled under an appropriate quality system in accordance with Agreed Standards, as more fully described in the Quality Agreement (as applicable).

provisions.summary: The Parties must discuss and agree in writing on any change to Miltenyi’s quality system that would have a material effect on the safety, efficacy, identity and/or quality of a Miltenyi Product or its Permitted Use.
provisions.text: Any subsequent change to Miltenyi’s quality system that, as Bellicum can reasonably establish, would have or is likely to have a material effect on the safety, efficacy, identity and/or quality of a Miltenyi Product or its Permitted Use, requires the Parties to discuss and agree upon each such change in writing.

provisions.summary: The Parties must enter into a Quality Agreement within a specified period detailing quality assurance obligations.
provisions.text: the Parties shall enter into an agreement on mutually acceptable, commercially reasonable terms that details the quality assurance obligations of each Party relating to Clinical Grade Products (the “Quality Agreement”).

provisions.summary: Miltenyi reserves the right to make changes to Product Specifications, Agreed Standards, and other aspects of Miltenyi Products during the Term.
provisions.text: Miltenyi reserves the right to periodically make changes to the Product Specifications, Agreed Standards and/or otherwise with respect to the properties, manufacture and/or testing of the Miltenyi Products (including changes with respect to: suppliers of raw materials; quality in raw materials; methods of manufacturing; packaging; equipment and/or premises; Subcontractors; product control techniques and methods of analysis; product release specifications; and/or presentation and content of relevant documentation, including certificates pursuant to Section 6.5) from time to time during the Term (each, a “Change”).

provisions.summary: Change notifications must be provided in accordance with the applicable notification procedures.
provisions.text: Change notifications shall be provided in accordance with the applicable notification procedures set forth in the Quality Agreement or in this Agreement.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must give Bellicum at least a specified number of months’ advance written notice prior to implementation of a proposed Material Change, unless it is a Required Change with compelling reasons for earlier implementation.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall give Bellicum at least [...***...] months’ advance written notice prior to implementation of the proposed Material Change (a “Change Notification”).

provisions.summary: Miltenyi shall be responsible for drafting relevant documentation and providing Bellicum all information reasonably necessary for regulatory filings regarding any Change.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall be responsible for drafting relevant documentation and shall provide to Bellicum all information reasonably necessary for Bellicum to make appropriate filings with the applicable Regulatory Authority regarding any Change under this subsection, if applicable.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must use efforts to implement a Required Change at its cost.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall use [...***...] to implement such Required Change at its cost.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must use efforts to implement a Bellicum-Specific Required Change only if and to the extent Bellicum agrees to reimburse Miltenyi for all documented costs and expenses.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall use [...***...] to implement such Bellicum-Specific Required Change only if and to the extent Bellicum agrees to reimburse Miltenyi for all documented costs and expenses reasonably incurred by Miltenyi as a result of any such Bellicum-Specific Required Change.

provisions.summary: Prior to implementing a Required Change, Miltenyi must promptly advise Bellicum as to any scheduling and/or Product Price adjustments.
provisions.text: Prior to implementing a Required Change in accordance with this Section 3.2(c), Miltenyi shall promptly advise Bellicum as to any scheduling and/or Product Price adjustments which may result from any such Required Change, if any.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi and Bellicum must negotiate in good faith to reach agreement on new Product Price, responsibility for costs, and amendments necessitated by a Required Change.
provisions.text: Miltenyi and Bellicum shall negotiate in good faith in an attempt to reach agreement on (i) the new Product Price, if any, for any Miltenyi Product which embodies such Required Change, giving due consideration to the effect of such change on Miltenyi’s manufacturing costs for the changed Miltenyi Product as well as any other relevant factors, (ii) the responsibility for any costs and expenses associated with Miltenyi’s activities required to implement such Change, and (iii) any other amendments to this Agreement which may be necessitated by such Change (e.g., an adjustment to the lead time for firm orders).

provisions.summary: Miltenyi has no obligation to implement a Bellicum-Specific Required Change unless and until the Parties have reached agreement on all items described.
provisions.text: For clarity, Miltenyi shall have no obligation to implement a Bellicum-Specific Required Change unless and until the Parties have reached agreement on all items as described in the preceding sentence.

provisions.summary: Bellicum must notify Miltenyi in writing if it desires Miltenyi to make a Bellicum-Requested Change.
provisions.text: Bellicum shall notify Miltenyi thereof in writing.

provisions.summary: Implementation of a Bellicum-Requested Change is subject to Miltenyi’s consent.
provisions.text: Implementation of any such proposed Bellicum-Requested Change shall be subject to Miltenyi’s consent.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi may withhold its consent to a Bellicum-Requested Change if it reasonably determines the change does not comply with standards, laws, or could adversely impact its manufacturing or sales.
provisions.text: Miltenyi may withhold its consent to an Bellicum-Requested Change if Miltenyi reasonably determines that such change (i) does not comply with Agreed Standards, Applicable Laws or the requirements of Miltenyi’s applicable Regulatory Authority, or (ii) could have potential adverse impact on Miltenyi’s manufacturing activities or the sale of the respective Miltenyi Product to other customers.

provisions.summary: A technical and cost review for a Bellicum-Requested Change must be conducted promptly and in good faith by Miltenyi, at Bellicum’s cost, and is subject to agreement on costs and price revisions.
provisions.text: a Bellicum-Requested Change shall only be implemented following a technical and cost review which shall be conducted as promptly as is reasonably possible and in good faith by Miltenyi, at Bellicum’s cost, and shall be subject to Miltenyi and Bellicum reaching agreement as to the one-time costs and revisions to the Product Price necessitated by any such Bellicum-Requested Change.

provisions.summary: If Bellicum agrees to reimburse Miltenyi for all documented costs and accepts a proposed Product Price adjustment, Miltenyi shall use efforts to implement the proposed Bellicum-Requested Change.
provisions.text: If Bellicum agrees to reimburse Miltenyi for all documented costs and expenses reasonably incurred by Miltenyi as a result of the proposed Bellicum- Requested Change and accepts a proposed Product Price adjustment that reflects a change in Miltenyi manufacturing costs resulting from such Bellicum-Requested Change, Miltenyi shall use [...***...] to implement the proposed Bellicum-Requested Change.

provisions.summary: An agreed adjustment to the Product Price becomes effective only for orders manufactured in accordance with the Bellicum-Requested Change.
provisions.text: For clarity, an agreed adjustment to the Product Price shall become effective only with respect to orders for Miltenyi Products that are manufactured in accordance with the Bellicum-Requested Change.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must notify Bellicum before implementing a Miltenyi-Requested Change.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall notify Bellicum in accordance with the Change Notification procedures set forth in Section 3.2(b) and the Quality Agreement before implementation of such Miltenyi-Requested Change (including at least 6 months advance written notice prior to implementation)

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must keep Bellicum advised of its efforts to effectuate the change.
provisions.text: and shall keep Bellicum advised of its efforts to effectuate such change.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must use best efforts to provide Bellicum with samples of Changed Miltenyi Product.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall use its best efforts to provide to Bellicum with a commercially reaosnable number of samples of the “Changed Miltenyi Product” ... for evaluation by Bellicum as soon as such Changed Miltenyi Product becomes available during the post-noficiation period.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must draft relevant documentation and provide Bellicum with necessary information for regulatory filings.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall be responsible for drafting relevant documentation and shall provide to Bellicum any information reasonably necessary for Bellicum to make appropriate filings with the applicable Regulatory Authority for Bellicum to obtain any required amendment or other modification of the Bellicum Product regulatory approvals regarding changes under this subsection, if applicable.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must implement Miltenyi-Requested Change at its own cost and expense.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall implement such Miltenyi-Requested Change at its own cost and expense.

provisions.summary: Bellicum has no obligation to purchase Changed Miltenyi Products if it does not agree the change is acceptable.
provisions.text: Bellicum has no obligation to purchase any such Changed Miltenyi Products.

provisions.summary: The Parties must cooperate, share information, and act in good faith to prepare documentation for regulatory approvals or permits.
provisions.text: the Parties shall cooperate, share information, and otherwise act in good faith to prepare the appropriate documentation as may be necessary to secure and maintain appropriate regulatory approvals or manufacturing permits for Miltenyi Product and Bellicum Product, respectively.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must continue to supply unchanged Miltenyi Product for a reasonable period for Bellicum to make regulatory filings, except in certain circumstances.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall continue to supply Miltenyi Product without the proposed Material Change for as long a period as is reasonably required for Bellicum, using [...***...], to make all appropriate filings and obtain any required amendment or modification of existing regulatory approvals for Bellicum Product (unless otherwise agreed, such period not to exceed six

provisions.summary: Bellicum has no obligation to purchase Miltenyi Products produced after a Material Change until agreement is reached on costs and revisions.
provisions.text: Bellicum has no obligation to purchase any such Miltenyi Products produced after implementation of such Material Change.

provisions.summary: The Parties must promptly meet to discuss in good faith if continued supply of unchanged Miltenyi Product is estimated to exceed three or six months.
provisions.text: then the Parties shall promptly meet to discuss in good faith how to remedy the situation.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must continue to supply unchanged Miltenyi Product after the 6-month period and during the Term if Bellicum rejects a Material Change, or until Bellicum secures an alternate source.
provisions.text: Miltenyi will continue to supply the applicable Miltenyi Product without such change after expiry of the said 6-month period and during the Term of this Agreement, or until Bellicum has secured an alternate source of supply from a Third Party manufacturer

provisions.summary: The Parties must discuss in good faith and agree in writing on terms to reflect increased cost and effort for unchanged Miltenyi Product.
provisions.text: the Parties will discuss in good faith, reflecting the change in circumstances contemplated by this Section 3.2(h), and agree in writing upon commercially reasonable terms to be set forth in an amendment to this Agreement to reflect any demonstrable increased cost and effort (if any) resulting from the manufacture of unchanged Miltenyi Product solely for Bellicum

provisions.summary: Miltenyi is relieved from any obligation to supply unchanged Miltenyi Product after the period described if the Parties cannot reach agreement.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall be relieved from any obligations to supply such affected (unchanged) Miltenyi Product under this Agreement after the period described in the first sentence of this subsection (h) ends.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi is not required to manufacture, supply or sell an existing Miltenyi Product to which a Required Change must be applied.
provisions.text: in no event shall Miltenyi be required to manufacture, supply or sell an existing Miltenyi Product to which a Required Change must be applied.

provisions.summary: Notification and continued supply obligations do not apply to Research Grade Products.
provisions.text: The notification requirements of the second sentence of Section 3.2(b) of this Agreement with respect to Material Changes and the obligations of Section 3.2(g) with respect to Continued Supply shall not apply to Research Grade Products.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must notify Bellicum at least 1 month in advance before implementing a Miltenyi-Requested Change for Research Grade Products.

provisions.text: Miltenyi shall ensure that, at the time of Delivery the remaining shelf life of each shipped Miltenyi Product shall be no less than the minimum shelf life set forth in Exhibit B as such Exhibit B Module may be amended from time to time by written notification of Miltenyi to Bellicum.

provisions.summary: The Parties agree to provide reasonable assistance to implement back-office changes for shelf life and production planning.
provisions.text: the Parties agree to provide to each other reasonable assistance where practicable to implement such back-office changes as necessary, taking into account cost, resource and capacity requirements.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must include proper certificates with all shipments in accordance with the Quality Agreement.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall include proper release certificates, certificates of compliance, and/or certificates of analysis with all shipments of Miltenyi Product, as applicable, in accordance with the requirements of the Quality Agreement.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must promptly notify Bellicum of any potential or anticipated shortfall in manufacturing or inventory.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall promptly notify Bellicum of any potential or anticipated shortfall in the manufacturing or inventory of any Miltenyi Product that may adversely affect the Delivery of such Miltenyi Product in accordance with Bellicum’s forecast requirements and pending Purchase Orders therefor.

provisions.summary: The Parties shall seek to agree on a revised delivery date if Miltenyi cannot supply a product.
provisions.text: the Parties shall, in good faith, seek to agree on a revised date (or dates) for Delivery

provisions.summary: Miltenyi shall undertake prompt and diligent efforts to mitigate the adverse impact on Bellicum if unable to supply.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall undertake prompt and diligent efforts to mitigate the adverse impact on Bellicum.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi shall provide Bellicum priority access to Miltenyi Product in case of limited availability, consistent with purchase volumes and medical needs.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall take into account the aggregate volume of Miltenyi Products purchased by Bellicum, and shall subject to reasonable ethical standards provide to Bellicum priority access to Miltenyi Product consistent with such Miltenyi Product purchase volumes and critical medical needs.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi shall use all necessary efforts to minimize shortfall and deliver ordered product as soon as possible if delivery fails due to fault, error, or force majeure.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall use all [...***...] that may be necessary in order to minimize the shortfall, and deliver the ordered Miltenyi Product as soon as possible.

provisions.summary: Bellicum may cancel Purchase Orders without penalty if Miltenyi fails to propose an acceptable delivery plan or if delay exceeds 30 days.
provisions.text: Bellicum may, at its reasonable election and notwithstanding anything to the contrary in the Agreement, cancel the Purchase Order(s) without penalty.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must devote adequate manufacturing capacity to ensure continuous supply to Bellicum, subject to certain limitations.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall use [...***...] have and devote adequate manufacturing capacity to ensure continuous supply of Miltenyi Products to Belicum in accordance with the Forecasts during the Term, in accordance with the provisions of this Section 6.7.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi is not required to incur significant expenses for new equipment or additional capacity.
provisions.text: Miltenyi’s compliance with this Section 6.7(a) shall not require Miltenyi to incur any significant expenses to purchase new equipment, to install equipment purchased or requested by Bellicum, or to add (or, for clarity, allocate or dedicate) additional manufacturing or storage capacity for the manufacturing and supply of Miltenyi Products to Bellicum hereunder.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must establish additional or alternative manufacturing capability at its option and expense if unable to meet forecast requirements from primary facility.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall determine, at its option and expense, to establish additional or alternative manufacturing and supply capability for the Miltenyi Products by qualifying and maintaining one or more back-up manufacturing facilities at the premises of Miltenyi and/or any of its Affiliates (each, a “Secondary Location”).

provisions.summary: Use of a Secondary Location must be notified to Bellicum in writing in accordance with Section 3.2.
provisions.text: Use of a Secondary Location must be notified to Bellicum in writing in accordance with the Change Notification processes set forth in Section 3.2.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi shall use best efforts to provide Bellicum with samples of Secondary Location Products for evaluation as soon as available.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall use its best efforts to provide to Bellicum with a commercially reasonable number of samples of the “Secondary Location Miltenyi Products” (meaning such Miltenyi Products that are produced at such Secondary Location) for evaluation by Bellicum as soon as each such Secondary Location Miltenyi Product becomes available during the post-noficiation period.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must provide Bellicum with at least six months' prior written notice before qualifying a Secondary Location.
provisions.text: it shall provide reasonable prior written notice thereof (not less than six (6) months in advance) to Bellicum, including such details as Bellicum reasonably requires to assess the qualifications of such Secondary Location.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi has sole responsibility for all activities in connection with the setup and approval of the Secondary Location.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall have sole responsibility for all activities in connection with the setup and approval of the Secondary Location, including for establishing proof of product equivalence for Miltenyi Products produced at the Secondary Location, process and equipment validation and for filing all submissions or other correspondence with Miltenyi’s applicable Regulatory Authorities in connection with the Secondary Location.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi may have products manufactured by a subcontractor.
provisions.text: Miltenyi may from time to time determine, in its sole discretion, to have one or more Miltenyi Products manufactured, assembled and/or supplied, in whole or in part, by a Subcontractor chosen by Miltenyi and reasonably acceptable to Bellicum.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must provide Bellicum with prior written notification of a change in subcontractor.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall provide Bellicum with prior written notification of such Change in accordance with the applicable notification procedures as set forth in the Section Change Control and in the Quality Agreement, if applicable.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi remains responsible for its supply and other obligations even if a subcontractor is used.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall remain responsible for the fulfilment of its supply and other obligations hereunder with respect to any Miltenyi Product manufactured by Miltenyi’s Subcontractor.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi is solely responsible for providing proof of product equivalence and for regulatory filings regarding subcontractor sites.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall be solely responsible for providing proof of product equivalence and for filing all submissions or other correspondence with the applicable governmental or regulatory authorities in connection with any decision to seek approval of a Third Party subcontractor site for the Miltenyi Products.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi is solely responsible for process and equipment validation and for passing government inspection.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall be solely responsible for all process and equipment validation required by the responsible Regulatory Authorities and the regulations thereunder and shall take all steps reasonably necessary to pass government inspection by such Regulatory Authorities

provisions.summary: The Parties must discuss and agree on minimum inventory requirements for Miltenyi Products.
provisions.text: the Parties shall from time to time discuss in good faith and mutually and reasonably agree upon (i) whether one or more Miltenyi Products require a minimum inventory to be held by Bellicum, and (ii) whether there shall be any type of Miltenyi Product that require a minimum inventory to be held by Miltenyi on behalf of Bellicum and under which terms and conditions such minimum inventory shall be reserved for Bellicum.

provisions.summary: Bellicum may request Miltenyi to establish a Secondary Location in the event of a Supply Failure.
provisions.text: Bellicum shall have the option to request Miltenyi to establish, as soon as reasonably feasible and at Miltenyi’s sole cost and expense, a Secondary Location reasonably capable of making up the Supply Failure of the affected Miltenyi Product (the “Affected Miltenyi Product”)

provisions.summary: If requested, Miltenyi must establish a Secondary Location to make up the Supply Failure, unless it notifies Bellicum it is not willing/capable or fails to do so in a reasonable time.
provisions.text: if Miltenyi should either (i) notify Bellicum in writing that it is not willing and/or capable to establish a Secondary Location, or (ii) should not have established such Secondary Location and made up the Supply Failure within a reasonable period of time with regard to the Affected Miltenyi Product from receipt of Bellicum’s written request therefore, then Bellicum shall, at Bellicum’s sole cost and expense, have the right to select, qualify, and maintain an additional second source manufacturing facility as a back-up manufacturing facility for the Affected Miltenyi Products at the premises of a Third Party (the “Second-Source Supplier”).

provisions.summary: Bellicum may select, qualify, and maintain a Second-Source Supplier if Miltenyi does not establish a Secondary Location.
provisions.text: then Bellicum shall, at Bellicum’s sole cost and expense, have the right to select, qualify, and maintain an additional second source manufacturing facility as a back-up manufacturing facility for the Affected Miltenyi Products at the premises of a Third Party (the “Second-Source Supplier”).

provisions.summary: Bellicum must provide Miltenyi with prior written notice and details when qualifying a Second-Source Supplier.
provisions.text: it shall provide Miltenyi with prior written notice to Miltenyi including such details as Miltenyi reasonably requires to assess the qualifications of such Second-Source Supplier.

provisions.summary: Bellicum may not select a Second-Source Supplier that is a Miltenyi Competitor.
provisions.text: Bellicum may proceed with an alternative Second-Source Supplier of its choice (however not a Miltenyi Competitor) without Miltenyi’s consent.

provisions.summary: If Miltenyi withholds consent for a Second-Source Supplier, it must propose alternatives reasonably acceptable to both parties.
provisions.text: If Miltenyi so withholds its consent, it shall propose alternative Second-Source Suppliers reasonably acceptable to both Miltenyi and Bellicum.

provisions.summary: If the parties fail to identify a mutually acceptable Second-Source Supplier within 30 days, Bellicum may proceed with an alternative supplier.
provisions.text: If the Parties fail to identify a mutually acceptable Second-Source Supplier within thirty (30) days, Bellicum may proceed with an alternative Second-Source Supplier of its choice (however not a Miltenyi Competitor) without Miltenyi’s consent.

provisions.summary: Any Second-Source Supplier must provide undertakings to Miltenyi to protect its Confidential Information.
provisions.text: Any such Second-Source Supplier shall, as a condition of qualification, provide reasonable and customary undertakings to Miltenyi related to the protection of Miltenyi’s Confidential Information.

provisions.summary: Bellicum is primarily responsible, with Miltenyi’s reasonable cooperation, for proof of product equivalence and regulatory filings for Second-Source Suppliers.
provisions.text: Bellicum shall be primarily responsible, with Miltenyi’s reasonable cooperation and assistance, for providing proof of product equivalence and for filing all submissions or other correspondence with the applicable governmental or regulatory authorities in connection with any decision to seek approval of a manufacturing facility as Second-Source Supplier for Affected Miltenyi Product.

provisions.summary: Bellicum is primarily responsible, with Miltenyi’s reasonable assistance, for process and equipment validation and passing government inspection for Second-Source Suppliers.
provisions.text: Bellicum shall be primarily responsible, with Miltenyi’s reasonable assistance, for all process and equipment validation required by the responsible Regulatory Authorities and the regulations thereunder and shall take all steps reasonably necessary to pass government inspection by such Regulatory Authorities.

provisions.summary: Second-Source Supplier may manufacture Affected Miltenyi Product under license if Supply Failure occurs.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall grant Bellicum’s Second-Source Supplier a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable, one-site production license, without the right to sublicense, under Miltenyi’s Intellectual Property Rights solely to the extent reasonably necessary to manufacture the Affected Miltenyi Product for the Permitted Use by Bellicum at Bellicum’s cost.

provisions.summary: Second-Source Supplier may not manufacture Miltenyi Products not subject to Supply Failure.
provisions.text: a Second-Source Supplier’s license under this subsection shall not permit the manufacture of any Miltenyi Product that is not subject to Supply Failure.

provisions.summary: Second-Source Supplier's license continues until Miltenyi and Bellicum agree on alternatives.
provisions.text: A Second-Source Supplier’s license hereunder shall subsist until such time as Miltenyi and Bellicum reach agreement on alternative license and/or supply arrangements

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must provide Second-Source Supplier with access to manufacturing documentation and know-how.
provisions.text: provide the Second-Source Supplier, subject to a non-disclosure agreement on terms no less restrictive than those set forth herein, with prompt access to the documentation, protocols, assays, SOPs, materials, including biological materials, and other know-how and information constituting the manufacturing process of the Affected Miltenyi Product(s)

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must assist Second-Source Supplier with use of Miltenyi’s technology.
provisions.text: assist the Second-Source Supplier with the working up and use of Miltenyi’s technology, including providing a reasonable level of technical assistance and consultation

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must provide additional disclosures and technical assistance to Second-Source Supplier.
provisions.text: provide the Second-Source Supplier with additional disclosures of information and technical assistance and consultation as necessary to keep the Second-Source Supplier informed of the then-current Miltenyi Intellectual Property Rights and the then-current manufacturing process(es) for the Affected Miltenyi Product(s)

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must provide other assistance to Bellicum and Second-Source Supplier as reasonably required for the license.
provisions.text: provide such other assistance to Bellicum and the Second-Source Supplier as may be reasonably required to give effect to such license.

provisions.summary: Bellicum must pay for work by Miltenyi in establishing and maintaining Second-Source Supplier unless Miltenyi is in material breach.
provisions.text: Bellicum will pay for work requested by Bellicum and conducted by or on behalf of Miltenyi, and reimburse Miltenyi for all reasonable and necessary costs and expenses incurred by Miltenyi, in establishing and maintaining Bellicum’s Second-Source Supplier for an Affected Miltenyi Product.

provisions.summary: Bellicum or its designated recipient must promptly inspect each shipment of Miltenyi Product upon Delivery.
provisions.text: Bellicum or (for Miltenyi Product purchased by Bellicum but shipped directly to a Bellicum’s Affiliate, Subcontractor, or Licensee) Bellicum’s designated recipient of the shipment of Miltenyi Product will promptly upon Delivery visually inspect each shipment of Miltenyi Product delivered hereunder to (i) determine whether such Miltenyi Product is damaged and (ii) verify that the quantity of Miltenyi Product delivered conforms with the Purchase Order and other applicable documentation.

provisions.summary: Bellicum must perform or have performed incoming quality assurance testing on each shipment.
provisions.text: Bellicum shall have a period of [...***...] days from the date of Delivery to perform, or have its Affiliate, Subcontractor, or Licensee (as the case may be) perform, incoming quality assurance testing on each shipment of Miltenyi Product in accordance with the Bellicum-approved quality control testing procedures as set forth in the Product Specifications or the Quality Agreement, as applicable (the “Testing Methods”), to verify conformance with the Product Specifications.

provisions.summary: Bellicum is not required to inspect or test Miltenyi Products beyond agreed Testing Methods except as required by law.
provisions.text: For the avoidance of doubt, Bellicum shall have no obligation under this Section 7.1 to inspect or test the contents of the Miltenyi Products other than as in accordance with the agreed Testing Methods, save as prescribed by Applicable Laws.

provisions.summary: Bellicum or its designee may reject any shipment not conforming to the Miltenyi Product Warranty.
provisions.text: Bellicum or its designee shall have the right to reject any shipment of Miltenyi Products that does not conform with the applicable Miltenyi Product Warranty at the time of Delivery when tested in accordance with the Testing Methods (each, a “Rejected Product”).

provisions.summary: Bellicum must provide Miltenyi with written notice of rejection within specified days, describing reasons and non-conforming characteristics.
provisions.text: if Bellicum or its designated recipient of the shipment does not provide Miltenyi with written notice of rejection (a “Rejection Notice”) within [...***...] days from the date of receipt of the relevant shipment of Miltenyi Product, describing the reasons for the rejection and the non-conforming characteristics of such Rejected Product in reasonable detail.

provisions.summary: Bellicum has no recourse against Miltenyi for accepted Miltenyi Products except for latent defects.
provisions.text: Once a Delivery of Miltenyi Products is accepted or deemed accepted hereunder, Bellicum shall have no recourse against Miltenyi in the event any such Miltenyi Product is subsequently deemed unsuitable for use for any reason, except for Miltenyi Product that does not conform to the Miltenyi Product Warranty after said 30-day period due to a latent defect in the Miltenyi Product that could not be detected through the performance of the Testing Methods.

provisions.summary: Bellicum may reject accepted Miltenyi Product for latent defects under certain conditions.
provisions.text: Bellicum shall have the further right to reject such quantities of Miltenyi Product accepted or deemed accepted pursuant to Section 7.2 above by providing a Rejection Notice on the grounds that all or part of the shipment fails to comply with the Miltenyi Product Warranty to the extent such non-conformance could not have reasonably been determined by visual inspection or incoming quality assurance testing in accordance with Section 7.1, provided that the applicable shelf-life of the Miltenyi Product has not expired and such non-conformance is unrelated to the shipping or storage of the Miltenyi Product after Delivery.

provisions.summary: Bellicum must notify Miltenyi of latent defects within specified days after discovery.
provisions.text: Notification to Miltenyi by Bellicum must occur within [...***...] days after Bellicum or Bellicum’s designated recipient of the shipment becomes aware or reasonably should have become aware that the Miltenyi Product fails to comply with the Miltenyi Product Warranty.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must notify Bellicum in writing whether it accepts the basis for rejection after receiving a Rejection Notice.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall notify Bellicum in writing as soon as reasonably practical whether or not it accepts Bellicum’s basis for rejection

provisions.summary: Bellicum must reasonably cooperate with Miltenyi in determining if rejection was justified.
provisions.text: Bellicum shall reasonably cooperate with Miltenyi in determining in good faith whether such rejection was necessary or justified.

provisions.summary: Upon Miltenyi’s request, Bellicum must provide evidence of proper transport, storage, and handling and testing data for Rejected Product.
provisions.text: Upon Miltenyi’s reasonable request, Bellicum shall provide, or cause its designees to provide, (i) evidence of appropriate transport, storage and handling for any Rejected Product in accordance with the storage and handling instructions set forth in the applicable Product Specifications; and (ii) reasonable testing data demonstrating that the Miltenyi Product in question does not conform to the Miltenyi Product Warranty.

provisions.summary: If parties cannot agree on conformity, the question must be submitted to an independent lab, whose findings are binding.
provisions.text: If the Parties are unable to agree as to whether a shipment of Miltenyi Products supplied by Miltenyi hereunder conforms to the applicable Miltenyi Product Warranty, such question shall be submitted to an independent quality control laboratory mutually agreed upon by the Parties. The findings of such independent quality control laboratory shall be binding upon the Parties.

provisions.summary: The cost of the independent lab is borne by the party whose results were incorrect.
provisions.text: The cost of the independent quality control laboratory shall be borne by the Party whose results are shown by such laboratory to have been incorrect.

provisions.summary: Bellicum may not return or destroy any batch of Miltenyi Products until written notification from Miltenyi.
provisions.text: Bellicum may not return or destroy any batch of Miltenyi Products until it receives written notification from Miltenyi that Miltenyi does not dispute that such batch fails to conform to the applicable Miltenyi Product Warranty.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must indicate in its notice whether Bellicum is authorized to destroy or must return the rejected batch.
provisions.text: Miltenyi will indicate in its notice either that Bellicum is authorized to destroy the rejected batch of Miltenyi Products, or that Miltenyi requires return of the rejected Miltenyi Products.

provisions.summary: Upon written authorization, Bellicum must promptly destroy the rejected batch and provide written certification.
provisions.text: Upon written authorization from Miltenyi to do so, Bellicum shall promptly destroy the rejected batch of Miltenyi Products and provide Miltenyi with written certification of such destruction.

provisions.summary: Upon request for return, Bellicum must promptly return the rejected batch to Miltenyi.
provisions.text: Upon receipt of Miltenyi’s request for return, Bellicum shall promptly return the rejected batch of Miltenyi Products to Miltenyi.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must reimburse Bellicum for documented, reasonable costs of destruction or return of rejected products.
provisions.text: In each case, Miltenyi will reimburse Bellicum for the documented, reasonable costs associated with the destruction or return of the rejected Miltenyi Products.

provisions.summary: Bellicum is not required to pay for properly rejected shipments.
provisions.text: Bellicum shall not be required to pay any invoice with respect to any shipment of Miltenyi Products properly rejected pursuant to this Section 7.2.

provisions.summary: Bellicum must pay for rejected shipments not returned or destroyed that are later found conforming.
provisions.text: Bellicum shall be obligated to pay in full for any rejected shipment of Miltenyi Products that is not returned or destroyed in accordance with Section 7.5 above, and that is subsequently determined to conform to the applicable Miltenyi Product Warranty, irrespective of whether Bellicum has already paid Miltenyi for a replacement shipment (but in such event, the replacement shipment will be Delivered to Bellicum and will be included in Bellicum’s Minimum Purchases).

provisions.summary: Bellicum is entitled to a refund/credit or replacement for properly rejected non-conforming shipments.
provisions.text: Bellicum shall be entitled, upon confirmation that such shipment failed to conform to the applicable Miltenyi Product Warranty, either, at Bellicum’s option: (i) to a refund or credit equal to the Product Price paid with respect to such rejected shipment (including without limitation, taxes paid and shipping expenses); or (ii) to require Miltenyi to promptly replace and Deliver to Bellicum an amount of Miltenyi Products that conforms to the requirements of this Agreement at no additional cost to Bellicum.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must replace and deliver conforming products at no additional cost if Bellicum exercises its right.
provisions.text: to require Miltenyi to promptly replace and Deliver to Bellicum an amount of Miltenyi Products that conforms to the requirements of this Agreement at no additional cost to Bellicum.

provisions.summary: Bellicum’s rights of rejection, return, refund and replacement do not apply to products damaged by Bellicum or after delivery.
provisions.text: Bellicum’s rights of rejection, return, refund and replacement set forth in this Article 7 shall not apply to any Miltenyi Product that is non-conforming due to damage (i) caused by Bellicum, its Affiliates, Subcontractors, or Licensees or their respective employees or agents, including but not limited to, misuse, neglect, improper storage, transportation or use beyond any dating provided, or (ii) that occurs after Delivery of such Miltenyi Product in accordance with this Agreement, including any damage caused thereafter by accident, fire or other hazard, and Miltenyi shall have no liability or responsibility to Bellicum with respect thereto.

provisions.summary: Bellicum must pay Miltenyi a non-refundable upfront fee in installments.
provisions.text: Bellicum will pay to Miltenyi a non-refundable upfront fee in the aggregate amount of two million Euro (€2,000,000) (the “Upfront Fee”). The Upfront Fee will be paid in installments, as follows: (a) a first installment of [...***...] Euro (€[...***...]), to be invoiced by Miltenyi following execution of this Agreement; (b) a second installment of [...***...] Euro (€[...***...]), to be invoiced by Miltenyi following the first anniversary of the Effective Date.

provisions.summary: Bellicum must pay Miltenyi milestone payments for each Bellicum Product.
provisions.text: Bellicum will pay to Miltenyi [...***...], one-time only milestone payments of [...***...] Euro (€[...***...]) each, [...***...] milestone payment corresponding to [...***...], and [...***...] milestone payment corresponding to [...***...], or [...***...], whatever comes earlier, respectively, of such Bellicum Product, as set forth in such Bellicum Product’s or Bellicum Program corresponding Module(s).

provisions.summary: Bellicum must reimburse Miltenyi for certain third party royalties and license fees.
provisions.text: Bellicum will reimburse Miltenyi for Third Party royalties and/or license fees, if any, owed by Miltenyi under Third Party license agreements existing as of the Effective Date as set forth on Exhibit D solely to the extent Miltenyi’s exercise of rights under such licenses is required

provisions.summary: The Parties must negotiate in good faith which party pays for additional third party royalties and license fees.
provisions.text: then the Parties will negotiate in good faith which Party(ies) is/are responsible for payment of such Third Party royalties and/or license fees.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi may defer inclusion of additional products until agreement on third party fees is reached.
provisions.text: Miltenyi, acting reasonably, reserves the right to defer the inclusion of additional Miltenyi Products in Exhibit B hereto until the Parties have reached agreement on this matter.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi agrees to sell and deliver, and Bellicum agrees to purchase, products at the listed price.
provisions.text: Miltenyi agrees to sell and Deliver and Bellicum agrees to purchase Miltenyi Products under and in accordance with this Agreement at the Purchase Price listed for each unit of a Miltenyi Product set forth on Exhibit E (the “Product Price”).

provisions.summary: Bellicum is entitled to a reduction of product prices based on volume thresholds.
provisions.text: Bellicum shall be entitled to a reduction of the Product Prices set forth in Exhibit F (collectively, the “Discounts”).

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must analyze purchases and apply higher discount levels if thresholds are exceeded.
provisions.text: Within the first Calendar Year, Miltenyi shall analyze Bellicum’s and its Subcontractors’ and Licensees’ purchases of Miltenyi Products at the end of each Calendar Quarter; if such purchases for a particular Miltenyi Product exceed the volume threshold of the then applicable Discount (based on binding and firm Purchase Orders received by Miltenyi in that Calendar Quarter), then, in the following Calendar Quarter, for all Purchase Orders regarding such Miltenyi Product, the corresponding higher Discount level in accordance with the volume thresholds as defined in Exhibit F shall apply.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi is entitled to modify the purchase price annually, subject to certain caps.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall be entitled to modify the Purchase Price for any Miltenyi Product as set forth in Section 8.3(a) above and Exhibit E on or after the commencement of each Calendar Year during the Term after Contract Year 1 in accordance with this Section 8.4(c), provided that there shall not be more than one (1) Purchase Price increase with respect to the same Miltenyi Product in any given Contract Year during the Term.

provisions.summary: The Parties must consult and agree in writing if price increases exceed a certain cap.
provisions.text: then the Parties shall consult each other, negotiate in good faith and agree in writing upon an adaptation of the applicable Discount to stay within the capping of a [...***...] percent ([...***...]%) increase, except for cases when such Purchase Price increase is the result of a documented increase of more than [...***...] ([...***...]%) in the cost of any raw materials, packaging and/or other components used in the manufacture of Miltenyi Product and Miltenyi, at Bellicum’s request, has provided reasonable documentation evidencing such changes in production costs.

provisions.summary: Adjusted purchase price charged to Bellicum cannot exceed Miltenyi’s then-current list prices.
provisions.text: It is however expressly agreed between the Parties that the adjusted Purchase Price charged to Bellicum for Miltenyi Product supplied hereunder shall in no event exceed Miltenyi’s then-current list prices for such Miltenyi Product as in effect in the country of destination or use of the applicable Miltenyi Product, as published from time to time in Miltenyi’s applicable product catalogue.

provisions.summary: Product Price increases are not limited for certain changes.
provisions.text: the limitations on Product Price increases set forth in Section 8.3(c) above shall not apply to Product Price adjustments resulting from a Required Change or a Bellicum-Requested Change pursuant to Section 3.2(d) hereof.

provisions.summary: Bellicum must pay undisputed and properly due payments within specified days of invoice receipt.
provisions.text: all undisputed and properly due payments are payable within [...***...] days of Bellicum’s receipt of each invoice corresponding to a shipment of Miltenyi Products by Miltenyi, such invoices to be issued by Miltenyi or the applicable Miltenyi Affiliate in the Forecast Territory.

provisions.summary: Bellicum must make all payments by wire or electronic transfer in local currency.
provisions.text: Bellicum shall make all payments by wire transfer or electronic fund transfer in immediately available funds to an account designated by Miltenyi or its local Affiliate in the Forecast Territory, as applicable. All payments by Bellicum to Miltenyi or its Affiliate (as the case may be) under this Agreement shall be made in the local currency that applies to the Miltenyi company that is assigned to fulfill the respective Purchase Order for Miltenyi Products.

provisions.summary: Bellicum must pay amounts exclusive of sales tax and VAT.
provisions.text: All sums payable by Bellicum under this Agreement are stated exclusive of sales tax and VAT.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi may assess a late fee on overdue payments.
provisions.text: Miltenyi reserves the right to assess a late fee equal to [...***...] percent ([...***...]%) per month, or if lower, the maximum amount permitted by Applicable Law, on all undisputed and properly due amounts not paid by Bellicum when due.

provisions.summary: Bellicum acknowledges failure to pay is a material breach.
provisions.text: Bellicum acknowledges that failure by Bellicum to comply with its payment obligations in this Article 8 shall constitute a material breach.

provisions.summary: Bellicum may not exercise setoff or deduction rights except as provided.
provisions.text: Except as expressly provided herein, Bellicum shall not exercise any right of setoff, net-out or deduction, take any credit, or otherwise reduce the balance owed to Miltenyi with respect to any payments under this Agreement, unless the Parties otherwise agree or until Bellicum has obtained a final and non-appealable judgment against Miltenyi in the amount asserted by Bellicum.

provisions.summary: Each Party must deliver proof of payment of withholding taxes upon request.
provisions.text: Each Party shall deliver to the other Party, upon request, proof of payment of all such withholding taxes.

provisions.summary: Each Party must provide reasonable assistance to the other in seeking tax benefits.
provisions.text: Each Party shall provide reasonable assistance to the other Party in seeking any benefits available to such Party with respect to government tax withholdings by any relevant law, regulation or double tax treaty.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi may suspend performance if Bellicum fails to pay and does not cure after notice.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall have the right to suspend its performance under this Agreement if and to the extent Bellicum materially fails to perform its payment obligations under this Agreement and fails to cure such failure within five Business Days after confirmed receipt of a notice of breach from Miltenyi.

provisions.summary: Bellicum may suspend payment if Miltenyi materially fails to perform.
provisions.text: Bellicum shall have the right to suspend payment under this Agreement if and to the extent Miltenyi materially fails to perform its obligations under this Agreement.

provisions.summary: Bellicum or its agents may inspect Miltenyi’s Facilities under certain conditions.
provisions.text: Bellicum or Bellicum’s Licensees duly authorized agents, representatives or designees may inspect those portions of Miltenyi’s Facilities that are used to manufacture, store or conduct testing of Miltenyi Products to determine compliance with Agreed Standards, Applicable Laws and the applicable Quality Agreement.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must address and correct deviations identified in inspections.
provisions.text: Miltenyi shall promptly address and correct any deviations from Agreed Standards, Applicable Laws and/or the provisions of the applicable Quality Agreement identified in connection with such inspections.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi may exempt certain documentation from audit to protect IP.
provisions.text: Miltenyi reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to exempt certain documentation from such audit described in Section 9.1 if and to the extent this is reasonably required in order to protect Miltenyi’s trade secrets in Miltenyi Technology and/or other Miltenyi Intellectual Property Rights or Third Party Intellectual Property rights.

provisions.summary: Parties will discuss in good faith other means to provide information if exemption impacts inspection.
provisions.text: the Parties will discuss in good faith other means to provide sufficient information to such representative.

provisions.summary: Miltenyi must permit inspections by Regulatory Authorities and respond to requests.
